observations: Photo 0 shows two separate headlamp assemblies (clear lens, projector-style inner lens visible) laid on a tiled floor; both have mounting tabs/brackets attached.
Photo 0 also shows a tail lamp assembly (clear/amber sections visible) laid on the same tiled floor.
Photo 1 shows a front grille with a central badge/emblem; grille has vertical slats and chrome/black trim.
No visible part numbers, no readable model-year markings, and no clear brand/model text on the parts in the photos.

identity.kind: Prado front grille + headlamp/tail light assemblies (Toyota Land Cruiser Prado style)

claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition
claims.evidence: Photos show the parts physically, but there is no photo/video of the lights being powered to confirm working condition.
Location cannot be confirmed from the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment (Prado has multiple generations/years; grille and lamp housings differ by year/trim). Photos don’t show the exact year/part code.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of any label/stamp/part number on the back of each lamp and on the grille mounting area, plus a photo showing the connector type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: incompatible fitment / needs bracket or wiring adaptation.

risks.risk: Not actually working (bulbs/LEDs/reflector elements may be damaged; projector lens may be cloudy; internal wiring could be faulty).
risks.proof: Request a short video powering each lamp (headlamp and tail lamp) with the correct connector, showing both low/high (if applicable) and tail/indicator functions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not working / requires repair or bulb replacement.

risks.risk: Cracks, moisture ingress, or lens damage not obvious in these angles; mounting tabs may be broken.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of lens surfaces (front and back), all corners, and each mounting tab/clip—plus a photo of the inside reflectors.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: lens/clip damage that reduces usability or requires replacement.

risks.risk: Condition mismatch (seller may be mixing parts from different sides/variants; photo 0 shows two headlamp assemblies but doesn’t clearly confirm left/right pairing for the same vehicle spec).
risks.proof: Request photos showing left vs right markings (if any) and a photo of both lamps side-by-side with their connector ends.

proof_requests: Video test: power the headlamp(s) and tail lamp to confirm working functions (low/high and tail/indicator as applicable).
Close-up photos of part numbers/stamps on the back of each lamp and on the grille mounting area.
Photos of connector ends and mounting tabs/clips (front and back) to confirm fitment and completeness.
Confirm exact Prado generation/year (or VIN/part code) the parts came from; request a photo of the donor vehicle plate/VIN area if available.
response.reason: The photos show a grille and lamp assemblies, but the seller’s key claim (“working condition”) and the exact fitment (Prado year/variant) cannot be verified remotely from these images alone. To price safely, we need proof the lights work and that the parts match the correct Prado spec.
